witness_description: Take r=1, p=2, and F(x_1)=2x_1. Both residues 0 and 1 are zeros modulo 2, so c_2(F)=2.
refutation_explanation: The polynomial F is nonconstant over the integers and has degree 1, but c_2(F)=2 while deg(F) p^(r-1)=1*2^0=1. Thus 2>1, contradicting the claimed universal bound.
search_space: Exhaustively swept all 1,860 pairs with r=1, p in (2,3,5), degree d in (1,2,3), and coefficient tuple (a_0,...,a_d) in (0,1,-1,2,-2)^(d+1) with a_d nonzero; every residue x_1 in range(p) was tested. The first violation in this fixed order was retained.
